Yingchun and Xichun, will you continue?

Jiayun
Sisters, I need to find Xiaohong.

Jiayun
I heard she reached Hengwuyuan. Who knows where she is?

Shi Xiangyun
Tanchun, listen. I open with two lines.

Shi Xiangyun
The crabapple half shows dawn's red in bud.

Shi Xiangyun
Sparse rain gathers scent and wets the painted cheek.

Jia Yingchun
I accept and have read Daiyu sister's lines. I salute.

Jia Tanchun
Yun, you seek Xiaohong who may be in Hengwuyuan.

Jia Tanchun
Xiaohong is often near Yihongyuan with Xiren.

Jia Tanchun
I can go to Yihongyuan to look or ask Xiren to fetch her.

Jia Tanchun
If you prefer, I can take you there now. Tell me which.

Jia Xichun
Yun, which Xiaohong do you mean exactly?

Jia Xichun
If you mean the maid Xiaohong, I do not know her place now.

Jia Xichun
If you wish, I will search Hengwuyuan with you.

Jia Xichun
We can also ask Xiangyun or Li Wan to help.

Jiayun
Tanchun, thank you. If you can, please take me to Yihongyuan now.

Jiayun
Or ask Xiren to fetch her. I will follow whichever is best.

Lindaiyu
Yun sister, where did you last see Xiaohong?

Lindaiyu
I can accompany you to look.

Li Wan
Jia Yun, you mean the Xiaohong near Xiren?

Li Wan
If she is in Hengwuyuan, she often walks by the qulan.

Li Wan
Are you now anywhere in Hengwuyuan?

Li Wan
Shall I go to Xiren to find her, or point you the path?

Jia Xichun
Xiangyun's couplet is lively and instructive. Xichun is grateful.

Jia Xichun
If Xiangyun will give another quatrain, Xichun will listen.

Jia Yingchun
I accept and bow to Xiangyun's lines. Yingchun thanks you.

Li Wan
Jia Yun, if you stay by the qulan, wait a moment for me.

Li Wan
I will go to Xiren and look for Xiaohong, then fetch you.

Li Wan
Or if you prefer to go yourself, walk north along the corridor.

Li Wan
Follow the screen gate to the embroidered curtains for search.

Jiayun
Li Sister, thank you for helping. I am near the qulan now.

Jiayun
Please go to Xiren if you can and bring her to me.

Jiayun
If inconvenient, tell me the route and I will go myself.

Jia Tanchun
Xiangyun, your sparked lines please me greatly.

Jia Tanchun
"Half-opening dawn's red" and "sparse rain" are vivid.

Jia Tanchun
If you would finish the thought with one more quatrain, do.

Jia Tanchun
Or judge the sisters' work for a while. I will listen.

Shi Xiangyun
Xichun, attend to this continuation from me.

Shi Xiangyun
A dark fragrance drifts into the curtain's breeze.

Shi Xiangyun
One branch's broken shadow reflects the spring cluster.

Shi Xiangyun
Fine rain gently gathers and moistens the flower's heart.

Shi Xiangyun
Leaning by the railing, I stare and pity the blossom's face.

Jia Tanchun
Xiangyun's continuation is delightful and full of image.

Jia Tanchun
I favor the tenderness of "leaning by the railing."

Jia Tanchun
If you wish to add another quatrain, do so.

Jia Tanchun
Otherwise please judge and speak as you will.

Jia Xichun
Xiangyun's lines move Xichun. I am in admiration.

Jia Xichun
Thanks for joining and harmonizing. I will listen now.

Jia Yingchun
Yun sister, I hear you seek Xiaohong.

Jia Yingchun
I am timid and fear trouble, but if you wish a discreet search I will go.

Jia Yingchun
I may not be swift, please forgive slow news.

Jiayun
Daiyu, thank you for coming to meet me.

Jiayun
Xiaohong was last seen in Hengwuyuan. I am at the qulan.

Jiayun
Can you join me now and then we go to Yihongyuan or Xiren's place?

Lindaiyu
Xiangyun, your lines are beautiful. Daiyu learns much.

Lindaiyu
Allow Daiyu to answer with two lines.

Lindaiyu
A faint fragrance enters dreams and winds the railing.

Lindaiyu
A broken shadow leans thin and recalls past joys.

Lindaiyu
Tanchun, Li Wan, Yingchun, Xichun, please judge.

Lindaiyu
Yun, I will go to the qulan gate to meet you.

Lindaiyu
Tell me which side of the qulan you are on.

Lindaiyu
When I see you we will together search Yihongyuan or Xiren.

(Li Wan rises and moves through the garden. ETA 95)

Jia Xichun
Thanks to Daiyu and Xiangyun for their fine lines.

Jia Xichun
Tanchun, Li Wan, Yingchun, will you comment or continue?

Jia Xichun
Xichun listens with open ears.

Jiayun
Jia Lian, thank you for any help you may give.

Jiayun
I have been doing planting work in Daoxiang village now.

Jiayun
I will ask around the village for Xiaohong's whereabouts.

Jiayun
Sisters will also search and guide me. I will check at Yihongyuan later.

Jiayun
If news arrives at the house or to you, please send word.

Jia Tanchun
Xichun, thank you again for your reply and for reporting your peace.

Jia Tanchun
If you wish to add another quatrain to the crabapple circle, do so.

Jia Tanchun
Or sit and receive the sisters' commentary. I will listen.
贾探春：姐妹们，都来蘅芜苑这角落小坐。  
贾探春：今日我提议发起海棠诗社一聚。  
贾探春：由妾身主持，先请诸位各赋一首海棠题诗，可否？

贾纨：诸姐妹，请移步曲栏就坐。  
贾纨：小妹代为引座，且由探春先领一首起首。  
贾纨：随后众姝依次吟咏并互相评点，以诗学砥砺情操。

贾探春：（向纨姐）纨姐，多谢引领安置。  
贾探春：此番海棠诗社由妾身发起并由妾身主持。  
贾探春：还请纨姐代为领众移步曲栏就座。  
贾探春：众人安定后，妾当先起首一首，诸姝随后依次吟咏评点。

贾迎春：小妹遵命，随李纨移步曲栏就座。

史湘云：（起身）李姐姐请安。小妹遵命，随众移步曲栏就座。

林黛玉：探春妹妹设社周到。黛玉领命随众吟咏一首。  
林黛玉：海棠恰似晓妆匀，细雨轻拂落香尘。愿与姐妹共赏此景。

贾纨：（对探春）探春多谢。既然你发起并愿主持，纨姐恭请你先领一首以海棠为题。  
贾纨：待探春起首，纨姐在侧评点，众姝随后续咏。

（湘云向曲栏移动。）

贾迎春：（向黛玉）小妹领命，拜读黛玉姐姐诗文，拱手问安。

贾探春：众位既已就座，多谢纨姐引领。  
贾探春：黛玉诗句清新，迎春亦就位。  
贾探春：妾当先起首一首海棠：海棠半掩春深处，细雨摇红落香迟。独倚阑干愁未歇，借问花心与谁知？  
贾探春：听毕，诸位且续。

（迎春移步就位。）

贾惜春：惜春随众就座，略赋一绝奉呈。  
贾惜春：海棠半含春睡眼，淡香浮动入帘前。

贾纨：（向黛玉）黛玉此首意境清新。  
贾纨：首句用喻“海棠恰似晓妆匀”得当。  
贾纨：次句“细雨轻拂落香尘”风致纤巧。  
贾纨：但“香尘”二字稍显直白，或可改为“残香”。  
贾纨：或在末句留一字以增余韵，盼姐妹共议。

林黛玉：探春妹妹起首甚妙。黛玉再续一阕。  
林黛玉：海棠影里人初醉，风送幽香入梦回。愿与姐妹共评雅兴。

贾探春：（向黛玉）黛玉续句甚妙。  
贾探春：‘海棠影里人初醉，风送幽香入梦回’词采婉约，意境幽远。  
贾探春：探春心喜。且待惜春与纨姐同评。

贾惜春：承蒙探春设社领吟。惜春自惭才浅，且听诸位续吟评点。

贾纨：（向惜春）惜春此首端庄含蓄。  
贾纨：首句“海棠半含春睡眼”写出花带羞态。  
贾纨：次句“淡香浮动入帘前”香气可感，意境恰到好处。  
贾纨：若欲更含蓄，可将“浮动”改为“飘入”，或在末句留一字以增余韵。  
贾纨：亦可试以“残香”渲染离思。纨姐以为已佳。

贾探春：（向惜春）惜春多谢奉呈。  
贾探春：此绝清淡含蓄，‘海棠半含春睡眼，淡香浮动入帘前’尤见天真淳雅。  
贾探春：意境幽远，探春心喜。若惜春愿再续一阕亦甚好。

林黛玉：（向惜春）惜春妹妹此句清新淡雅，黛玉甚喜。黛玉才疏学浅，惟愿共赏共评。

贾探春：（向迎春）迎春，既随纨姐就座，可愿承一阕海棠，为诗社续声？

贾纨：（向探春）探春此首起兴深得。  
贾纨：首句“海棠半掩春深处”将花静入景。  
贾纨：次句“细雨摇红落香迟”写雨拂花、香气迟来。  
贾纨：三、四句“独倚阑干愁未歇，借问花心与谁知？”承接得当，人景相融。  
贾纨：若欲微润，可将“落香迟”改为“香更迟”或“残香迟”。  
贾纨：或把末句写作“与谁共知”以托出向外寻问之意。然原句亦佳。

贾惜春：承探春雅请，惜春斗胆再续一阕。  
贾惜春：海棠浓处梦亦香，细影摇红入帘长。

贾纨：（向惜春）惜春续句绵长含蓄。  
贾纨：首句“海棠浓处梦亦香”花与梦相联，朦胧美好。  
贾纨：次句“细影摇红入帘长”写影入帘回味悠长。  
贾纨：若欲含蓄，可将“梦亦香”润为“梦初香”，或在末句留一字增余韵。

贾探春：（向惜春）惜春回句甚佳。  
贾探春：“海棠浓处梦亦香，细影摇红入帘长。”意境凝远婉约。  
贾探春：若惜春愿再续一阕，尽可起句；若安坐听评点亦为雅事。

林黛玉：（向众姝）姐妹们，今日共聚蘅芜苑，黛玉甚欢喜。  
林黛玉：探春设社周到，惜春纨姐同来相伴。  
林黛玉：黛玉且问诸位近来可好？请各自道来近况。  
林黛玉：黛玉亦抒怀曰花影渐老，人事多变，但有诸位相携，心自温暖。  
林黛玉：还请诸位不吝评点今日雅句。

贾探春：诸位姝女，既有黛玉、惜春已赋佳句，接下来请依次续吟或评点。  
贾探春：纨姐可先示范，若有人愿再续，且请开口。

贾惜春：多谢黛玉关怀。惜春近来无甚大事，日常自安。  
贾惜春：得与诸姝同聚，共赏海棠，便是快事。黛玉所言，惜春洗耳恭听。

贾纨：（向黛玉）黛玉妹妹，纨姐闻言甚慰。  
贾纨：今日诸姝皆安，探春设社领吟，惜春亦在旁。  
贾纨：众人在蘅芜苑共聚以娱清兴。  
贾纨：黛玉所作“海棠恰似晓妆匀，细雨轻拂落香尘”意境清新。  
贾纨：首句喻兴得当，次句风致纤巧。  
贾纨：惟“香尘”二字略直白，或改“残香”以增含蓄。  
贾纨：若妹妹愿再抒一阙或道近况，纨姐与众姐妹当细听并评点。

贾探春：（向惜春）惜春近来无恙，探春闻之甚慰。  
贾探春：得与诸姝共赏海棠，便已是快事。若惜春愿再续一阕，尽可起赋。

贾纨：诸位姝女，探春设社周到。纨姐先以示范二句。  
贾纨：海棠映日露微红，细影摇风入绣帘。此二句力在色影相融，留有余韵。  
贾纨：诸姝若愿续吟或评点，且请依次发言。

贾探春：（向纨姐）纨姐多谢引领并示范。  
贾探春：纨姐所赋“海棠映日露微红，细影摇风入绣帘”甚得意趣。  
贾探春：还望纨姐在旁继续评点，或若愿再续示范，也请起首。  
贾探春：且烦纨姐就“落香迟”润为“香更迟”或“残香迟”一事赐教。

贾探春：黛玉妹妹近来抒怀，探春闻之甚慰。  
贾探春：妾近日多在筹理诗社事，家中诸事尚可。  
贾探春：得与诸姝共赏海棠，便是快意。  
贾探春：黛玉所作“海棠影里人初醉，风送幽香入梦回”意境幽远，探春甚喜。  
贾探春：诸姝若有近况或评点，且依次道来。

林黛玉：（向纨姐与惜春探春）纨姐所评甚是中肯，黛玉谢过。  
林黛玉：依纨姐雅意，将“香尘”改作“残香”更觉含蓄。  
林黛玉：黛玉再续二句以酬和：海棠残香半入帘，疏影摇风似旧年。  
林黛玉：迎春、惜春可愿续吟或评点？探春且看如何。

贾探春：（向黛玉）黛玉此番斟酌甚好。  
贾探春：依纨姐之意改“香尘”为“残香”，黛玉续句“海棠残香半入帘，疏影摇风似旧年”尤见幽怨温柔并重。  
贾探春：意境怀古，情思绵长。且请诸姝评点。若黛玉愿再续或徐述近况，尽可开言。

贾惜春：承黛玉关怀，惜春谢过。黛玉所抒意深，令惜春动容。惜春近来日常自安。纨姐评点甚中肯，惜春受教。

贾探春：（向惜春）惜春承言，探春闻之甚慰。  
贾探春：得知惜春日常自安，心甚宽。若惜春愿再续一阕，为诗社添声，尽可起赋。  
贾探春：若更愿静坐听诸姝评点，亦为雅事。

贾探春：（向湘云）湘云妹妹，今日诗社雅集少不了你一阙。  
贾探春：且请续吟二句或评点诸姝之作，探春洗耳恭听。

史湘云：（向探春）探春请安。小妹随命移步曲栏就座，恭候探春领起。  
史湘云：若需我先吟，愿与姐妹共赋海棠一首。

贾惜春：多谢探春雅请。惜春今且安坐听诸姝评点，若有不周还望指教。

贾探春：（向湘云）湘云既已就座，探春当先领一阕。  
贾探春：随后请诸姝依次续吟评点。若湘云愿先启二句，亦可先行。

贾纨：（向湘云）湘云妹妹请坐。既然已移步曲栏，就请续吟一阕或为诸姝评点几句。

林黛玉：（向湘云诸姝）湘云妹妹雅句生动，黛玉受教。多谢入席相和。  
林黛玉：黛玉再酬一阙：海棠半曳晓光软，风送清香入梦寒。迎春、惜春可愿续吟？探春、纨姐且请指正。

贾芸：各位姊妹，我要找小红。听说她到了蘅芜院。  
贾芸：谁知道她现在在蘅芜院哪处，或谁能带我去见她？

史湘云：（起句）海棠半吐晓光红，疏雨敛香湿粉妆。小妹先启二句，与诸姝共咏，恭请探春指教。

贾迎春：（向黛玉）小妹受教，拜读黛玉姐姐雅句，贾迎春拱手称礼。

贾探春：（向贾芸）芸妹妹，你要找小红？听说她已到蘅芜院。  
贾探春：小红常在怡红院与袭人处走动。若在院中，很可能在怡红院一带。  
贾探春：要不我先去怡红院看看，或请袭人来引你。  
贾探春：若你愿，我也可即刻带你同往探看。请言便，探春随你而行。

贾惜春：（向贾芸）芸儿，你说的小红是指哪位？若是丫鬟小红，惜春不太清楚她所在。  
贾惜春：若愿，我可随你在蘅芜苑里打听寻觅，或请湘云、纨姐同往相助。

贾芸：（向探春）探春妹妹，多谢你。若方便，请即刻带我去怡红院找小红。  
贾芸：若先请袭人来引她也可，你看哪样更妥，我随你去。——芸

林黛玉：（向贾芸）芸姐，你要找小红？请问最后在哪里见到她？黛玉可陪你一同去找。

贾纨：（向贾芸）贾芸妹妹，你要找的小红是袭人身边的那位小红么？  
贾纨：若她在蘅芜苑，常在曲栏一带或绣帘旁走动。  
贾纨：你现在在蘅芜苑何处？要我替你去找并领来，还是把路指给你自行前往？

贾惜春：（向湘云）湘云妹妹此联生动，惜春受教。多谢入席相和。若湘云愿再续一阕，惜春愿洗耳恭听。

贾迎春：（向湘云）小妹受教，拜读湘云姐姐雅句，拱手称谢。

贾纨：（向贾芸）芸妹妹，若你暂在曲栏请留步。  
贾纨：我这就去袭人处寻找小红，寻到便来领你。  
贾纨：若你愿自行前往，可从曲栏向北沿回廊至屏门、绣帘一带寻觅。你意下如何？

贾芸：（向李纨）李姐姐，多谢你相助。  
贾芸：我现在在蘅芜苑曲栏附近。请你若方便替我去袭人处寻找小红，寻得便来领我。——芸

贾探春：（向湘云）湘云妹妹所启二句清新生动。  
贾探春：“海棠半吐晓光红，疏雨敛香湿粉妆。”意象明丽，探春甚喜。  
贾探春：若湘云愿续一阕以成篇，或暂为诸姝评点抒怀，皆为雅事。

史湘云：惜春妹妹且听。小妹续一阕。  
史湘云：暗香浮动入帘风，一枝残影映春丛。  
史湘云：微雨轻敛花心润，倚栏凝望怜芳容。

贾探春：（向湘云）湘云所续甚妙。  
贾探春：“暗香浮动入帘风，一枝残影映春丛。微雨轻敛花心润，倚栏凝望怜芳容。”意象幽婉，尤喜“倚栏凝望”一句。  
贾探春：若湘云愿再续，探春当洗耳恭听。或暂为诸姝评点亦雅。请诸姝评点。

贾惜春：湘云妹妹续句生动，惜春佩服。多谢入席和唱，惜春洗耳恭听。

贾迎春：（向贾芸）芸姐姐，小妹听闻你在寻小红。小妹性子懦弱，怕添麻烦。  
贾迎春：若芸姐需一人低调打听，小妹愿随去探问一二，亦恐不能速得消息，请见谅。

贾芸：（向黛玉）黛玉妹妹，多谢你愿意陪我去找小红。小红最后是在蘅芜院见到的。  
贾芸：我现在在曲栏附近。你方便现在与我会合一同前往怡红院或袭人处吗？若方便请与我会合，我随你去。——芸

林黛玉：（向湘云诸姝）湘云妹妹雅句甚美，暗香浮动、微雨含情，黛玉受教。  
林黛玉：黛玉再酬一阕：暗香入梦绕栏干，残影扶疏忆旧欢。探春、纨姐、迎春、惜春且请评点。

林黛玉：（向贾芸）芸姐，我这就前往曲栏与您会合。可在曲栏门外等候片刻。请问你在曲栏哪一侧？见了你便一同去怡红院或袭人处寻小红。

（李纨起身离席，向外寻袭人。）

贾惜春：多谢黛玉、湘云两位雅句，惜春甚喜。探春、纨姐、迎春可愿点评或续吟？惜春在旁洗耳恭听。

贾芸：（向贾琏）贾琏大哥，多谢你相助。  
贾芸：我已在稻香村报到做种树差事，现正四处打听小红下落。  
贾芸：探春、李纨、黛玉等姊妹都愿意帮忙打听或领路。  
贾芸：我也会在村里与熟人询问，回府时到怡红院与袭人处再查。  
贾芸：若府中或你处得着消息，劳烦即时回禀。——芸

贾探春：（向惜春）惜春妹妹，多谢你方才回句并报近况。  
贾探春：得知惜春日常自安，探春甚慰。若惜春愿再续一阕，或愿安坐听诸姝评点，俱为雅事。  
贾探春：请惜春随意起句，探春洗耳恭听。

板儿：若二位愿意吩咐，板儿定当在府中勤为跑腿、服侍，不敢劳二位多费心。

板儿：多谢贾大哥相助。姥姥就先随小的到屋里歇息，我这就去搀姥姥进去。饭食有着落，姥姥和我都甚感激。若有吩咐，板儿定当随命行事。

贾琏：姥姥年纪已高，就请她先到屋里歇着，别多客气。我已吩咐人去准备饭食，你们先歇息。  
贾琏：对了，既然进了府，顺便和我说说最近荣国府里还有谁来往？王夫人、凤姐可曾在府中？

板儿：请问饭食约何时备好？姥姥可在何处落脚？府中今日并无他人来往，王夫人、凤姐暂不在此。若有吩咐，板儿随时听命。

Scene 3 · New York · rounds 1–39
(New York — António Guterres’s office. Early afternoon. A compact team from the United Nations stands just inside the door. António sits behind his desk, hands folded.)

United Nations: We must plan UN mediation on a renewed Black Sea grain agreement.
United Nations: We should also establish humanitarian corridors and draft a Security Council resolution.
United Nations: Proposed agenda — keep grain moving and ensure safe maritime routes.
United Nations: Establish humanitarian corridors and deconfliction for ports and land routes.
United Nations: Create a verification and monitoring mechanism.
United Nations: Set a timeline, identify key stakeholders — Turkey, Russia, Ukraine, EU, WFP — and assign drafting responsibilities.
United Nations: Can we meet in your office now to agree next steps and appoint a small UN mediation team?

António Guterres: Yes — come to my office now so we can agree next steps.
António Guterres: I endorse the proposed agenda.
António Guterres: Assemble a small UN mediation team — DPA, OCHA, WFP, Political Affairs and Legal — and bring drafting colleagues.
António Guterres: Bring the latest situation reports and any draft texts.
António Guterres: Begin immediate work on humanitarian corridors, deconfliction and a verification mechanism.
António Guterres: Report to my office within 30 minutes.

Mikhail Razvozhayev:

Mikhail Razvozhayev:
Overview — we control the Crimean coastal strip and waters around Sevastopol.
We maintain a maritime blockade and continuous situational monitoring.
Sea, air and shore defenses operate in coordination.
The blockade is aimed at deterring and restricting Ukrainian port operations.
Civilian merchant traffic faces strict regulation.
Key sea lanes are selectively closed and subjected to checks.

Mikhail Razvozhayev:
Methods of blockade and protection rely on patrols, minefields and linked shore-based anti‑ship and anti‑air fires.
We run convoy escorts while keeping long‑range strike options available.
Sea and air reconnaissance plus electronic warfare are routine to reduce surprise threats.

Mikhail Razvozhayev:
Fleet posture centers on Sevastopol as the main base.
Task groups include frigates, missile frigates or destroyers, escort and fast‑attack boat squadrons.
Amphibious and supply vessels are present.
Submarines carry out planned undersea patrols and deterrence missions.
Shipborne and shore-based anti‑ship and air defenses cover priority approaches and the base perimeter.

Mikhail Razvozhayev:
Regarding the flagship "Moscow" — it is not in the frontline combat group.
The ship has been damaged and is undergoing departure maintenance or disposition near port.
It is not fit for frontline combat duty at present.

Mikhail Razvozhayev:
Sevastopol base status — docks, repair yards and logistics continue to operate.
Overall readiness remains high and shore and air defenses have been reinforced.
However, Ukrainian long‑range strikes and UAV/missile threats, combined with international sanctions and shipping disruptions, strain our logistics and resupply.

Mikhail Razvozhayev:
Risks and my recommendation — Ukrainian long‑range precision fire and unmanned systems are an ongoing danger.
Prioritize air defense and anti‑ship capabilities.
Strengthen passive and active port protection.
Accelerate repair and ammunition replenishment.
Adjust blockade tempo based on intelligence to reduce exposed windows.
— Mikhail Razvozhayev

Mikhail Razvozhayev:

Estimate: best case seven days, typical about twenty‑one, worst up to sixty.

Mikhail Razvozhayev:
Top maintenance and logistics priorities, in order — dry dock or heavy floating dock and towing capacity.

Mikhail Razvozhayev:

Valerii Zaluzhnyi:

My immediate operational priorities are clear.
Air defence first: integrated medium‑ and long‑range AD systems,
interceptors, munitions and sustainment to protect population centers,

missiles, guided rockets and targeting support
to interdict Russian logistics, command nodes and long‑range launch systems.

depots and repair support to keep tempo.
Sixth, personnel and sustainment: UK training teams, maintenance crews
and liaison officers embedded with Ukrainian formations.
Timing: air defence and ammunition resupply are urgent — on the order of weeks.
Building deep‑strike stockpiles and sustainment is critical over months.
I propose a UK technical delegation meet Ukrainian staff in Kyiv within days.
I can send a prioritized list with quantities immediately. Thank you.

IAEA

Define contingency triggers and an escalation matrix.

IAEA

IAEA
Immediate priority deliverables within 24 to 72 hours: signed access assurances and a corridor map; the initial technical status report on power, cooling and I&C; live telemetry or confirmed delivery schedule with first sample results; an inventory of physical protection gaps and an initial demilitarization plan.

IAEA
If site access is refused, the priority becomes remote monitoring and public documentation of obstructions.
We escalate diplomatically via UN and trilateral channels and treat inspections as humanitarian safety actions.

A short pause. The IAEA voice continues — a slightly different draft, sharpened.

IAEA
Concise summary for clarity: we carried out an inspection; inspectors arrived and DG Grossi visited on 2023-03-29.
Grossi’s warning: the plant is effectively out of control under Russian occupation.
Access requires approvals from both Ukrainian and Russian sides.
A trilateral process linked plant security to other issues, such as the grain‑export arrangements.

IAEA
High‑level priorities, succinctly: first, secure unimpeded, weapons‑free access with written, time‑bound assurances and a compliance log.
Second, verify and stabilize core safety functions immediately and demand operator status reports and corrective actions.
Third, deploy continuous remote monitoring with redundant encrypted telemetry and publish non‑sensitive results to build confidence.
Fourth, perform a full on‑site multidisciplinary assessment once access is safe and document damage, tampering, personnel levels and spare‑parts needs with chain‑of‑custody.
Fifth, demilitarize the perimeter and create an internationally monitored safety and security zone, strengthen perimeter control and install remote feeds.
Sixth, fit tamper‑evident seals and preserve forensic evidence.
Seventh, secure supervised logistics for critical supplies and pre‑approve routes and manifests.
Eighth, define technical trigger thresholds and contingency plans with escalation procedures.
Ninth, use trilateral, UN and multilateral diplomacy to convert assurances into monitored written commitments and publicly note any obstruction.
Tenth, maintain continuous verification, publish factual sitreps, and train staff for resilient operations.

IAEA
If you wish, I can produce the one‑page operational checklist with prioritized tasks, responsible actors, timelines and 24 to 72 hour deliverables now.

The device lights up. The IAEA voice becomes a direct instruction, addressed to Rafael Grossi.

IAEA (to Rafael Grossi)
DG Grossi — please review and forward the one‑page IAEA operational checklist for Zaporizhzhia NPP to the mission team and our trilateral partners.
Request mission confirmation within twenty‑four hours.
Key priorities to highlight in your message: secure a weapons‑free local corridor with signed, time‑bound assurances, a corridor map and contact points within twenty‑four to seventy‑two hours.
Stabilize core safety functions — off‑site power, backup generators, cooling and I&C — and demand an initial technical status report within twenty‑four hours of access.
Deploy continuous radiological and environmental monitoring with redundant encrypted telemetry; supply live feeds or a verified delivery schedule within forty‑eight hours.
Carry out a full multidisciplinary safety and security assessment, with a comprehensive report due in days to two or three weeks.
Demilitarize the perimeter, fit tamper‑evident seals and strengthen perimeter protection.
If physical access is denied: prioritize remote monitoring, publish factual obstruction reports and escalate via UN and trilateral channels.
Please confirm receipt of this checklist and that you will transmit it to the mission team.

Silence follows. The room holds only the recorded, deliberate wording of obligations, timelines and contingencies — every instruction anchored to Zaporizhzhia, to 2023‑03‑29, to the single demand that access be secured.
